description: Reproducibility manifest for the historical Redux v4 density diagnostic

methodology.container_accounting: Payload bytes are byte-rounded independently in each modeled 4048-byte payload. Total container bytes are file header plus complete 4096-byte chunks and therefore include chunk headers and payload slack.
methodology.evaluation: In-sample diagnostic replay of each complete capture using the one shared profile; not an acceptance or generalization result
methodology.literal_miss_cost: Implemented v4 escape prefix plus two literal-kind bits plus the schema-shaped literal body
methodology.logical_replay: Decode each RDXTRC1 chunk as event-ID byte, ULEB delta, schema duration, and schema stored arguments; reconstruct one ordered logical stream; then independently repack it into fresh v3/v4 chunks
methodology.profile_mapping: Exact (three-state context, semantic event ID, delta, duration) tuples for same-track zero-stored-argument completed slices
methodology.source_limitations: The captures predate RBCT, use host time, embed no source revision or schema hash, and are interpreted with the checksum-pinned current Redux schema whose used IDs 0..220 retain the required shapes
methodology.v4_chunk_state: Timestamp base, default track, and model state 2 reset at each newly modeled v4 chunk

training.split_policy: none; concatenate both complete captures for one shared in-sample diagnostic profile
training.state_selection: explicit fixed pair from the prior bounded experiment; the preserved headline does not rerun automatic pair selection
